text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Returning from injury, Biko Pegasus takes 
on the New Zealand Trophy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before the race, an action star she had 
met before came to visit. Biko Pegasus was 
thrilled by the unexpected support.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, the action actor was troubled by 
repeatedly failing auditions. The reason 
seemed to be that being short made him 
lack presence.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Biko Pegasus cheers up the discouraged 
actor. She loudly vows that even with a 
small body, she will show that where 
there's a will, there's a way.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Running in the same race, Hishi Amazon 
burned with the desire to claim revenge 
against Biko Pegasus. And so, the 
much-anticipated race began!
